analysis.reasonEn: After the previous sell signal, RSI has exited oversold at 37.5, but the Lower High pattern persists with a 5-day range of $124.50-$171.50. MACD histogram improvement is noted but not yet a strong trend reversal signal. ADX at 47.9 indicates a strong trend, with -DI (41.3) still dominating +DI (17.1). The 52-week position at 20.9% remains low. Buy score increased slightly to 4 from 3, but maintaining a wait-and-see approach until trend reversal is confirmed.
